quote: In December 2024, Goldwind and ENGIE Chile successfully completed the full turbine installation at the Lomas de Taltal Wind Project… Goldwind successfully installed 57 units of GW165-6.0MW turbines at this site, totaling 342MW in capacity.
note: Opened Goldwind EN release 11 Mar 2025 (Lomas de Taltal 342 MW install Dec 2024).
